messages:
incident-bot: [P1] High GPU allocation failures in gcp-us-east1. Autoscaler repeatedly hitting cloud quota, queue growing. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota-hit
oncall-ash: Ack. I'm on pager. @sre-tilly please pull autoscaler and cloud API logs, @infra-lead-kim check reserved pools.
sre-tilly: grabbing logs now. seeing a stream of 403/QuotaExceeded from compute API starting ~14:01 UTC. Autoscaler attempted node creates then backed off.
ops-shaun: user-facing impact: p95/p99 for text-gen routes in us-east1 up ~3.5x, some 429s coming from edge LB. queue length ~2.8k.
eng-ml-raj: model pools show KV-cache growth, long requests accumulate. Memory on existing GPU nodes also climbing. Looks like a burst of large embedding jobs.
infra-lead-kim: Confirmed: no Dedicated capacity in us-east1 for this account. Autoscaler issued 5 create attempts -> GCP returned quotaExceeded per-region GPUS.
oncall-ash: Can we short-circuit autoscaler to stop hammering GCP? Repeated attempts make logs noisy.
sre-tilly: Adding a short-term circuit: will patch autoscaler to mark region as "quota-blocked" if repeated quota errors > 3 within 10m. Deploying now.
eng-platform-maya: While that's rolling, we can spin a CPU fallback nodepool and move non-SLA traffic. Spinning n1-standard fallback pool in us-east1. ETA ~3m.
ops-shaun: On routing: propose shifting low-priority traffic to us-west2 as well. Can we do a gradual weight shift?
oncall-ash: /run traffic-transfer --from=us-east1 --to=us-west2 --rate=15% --every=120s
eng-ml-raj: Also suggest lowering embedding batch sizes for prod in us-east1 to reduce per-request GPU time: set embeddings.batch_size=6 for affected route.
sre-tilly: autoscaler log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T14:01:22Z autoscaler: ScaleUpAttempt(5)
2026-03-17T14:01:26Z gcp: compute.instances.insert -> 403 QuotaExceeded (GPUS)
2026-03-17T14:02:00Z autoscaler: backoff 30s
2026-03-17T14:02:34Z ScaleUpAttempt(3)
2026-03-17T14:02:38Z gcp: compute.instances.insert -> 403 QuotaExceeded (GPUS)
```
ops-shaun: Implemented batch size drop for embeddings route. Watching metrics.
eng-platform-maya: cpu-fallback pool ready. Routing low-priority embed-only traffic to fallback now. Note: CPU fallback can't host large models; we'll only move embed-smol and rerank routes.
sales-ellie: FYI corpA is on support line, reporting embeddings failures. I'll send a short status note explaining degraded capacity and mitigation steps.
oncall-ash: Status check in 5m. Current mitigation: traffic weight ramp started, batch-size reduced, CPU fallback active, autoscaler circuit-breaker applied.
ops-shaun: Early effect: queue down from ~2800 -> ~900 in 9m, 429s reduced to ~5%. p99 latency down from 7.8s -> 3.1s.
infra-lead-kim: Opened a GCP quota case (GCP case: 987654321). Requested region GPU quota increase; ETA uncertain. If no progress in 45m escalate via partner channel.
eng-ml-raj: Suggest adding a model-variant fallback policy: route non-enterprise traffic to smaller quantized models automatically when region flagged degraded.
sre-tilly: Will add an alert and a metric (scale_attempts_with_quota_errors) to trigger earlier circuit-breaker. Also record as postmortem action item.
oncall-ash: Any remaining customer-impact concerns?
ops-shaun: A few customers on strict SLOs still see degraded throughput. We'll open support tickets and offer partial credits per SLA until full capacity restored.
eng-platform-maya: Also flag: when autoscaler marks region degraded, routing should prefer cross-region spillover earlier to avoid queue pile-up. Adding to backlog.
eng-ml-raj: Canary validation in us-west2 for shifted traffic looks ok so far. No model regressions observed.
oncall-ash: Closing pager for now; oncall will stay in channel for next 2 hours. Creating postmortem ticket and linking runbook. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident P1 -> mitigated (partial). Pager cleared by oncall-ash. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota-hit
